data.name: Moon In Ashes
data.detailed_description:
Haunted by endless nightmares, a young girl decides to inspect the weapon used in her parents’ murder.

But the moment she touches it, something unexpected happens.

Her body — and consciousness — are torn into another realm.

A decaying world drowned in cursed waters, forgotten ruins, monstrous creatures, and horrors beyond understanding. Reality feels broken here. The environment constantly shifts between beauty and terror, while something hidden watches from the darkness.

Trapped inside this fractured realm, she must survive deadly encounters, uncover disturbing truths, and find the connection between the weapon, the nightmare, and the world collapsing around her.

Explore a Dying World

Journey through atmospheric environments filled with abandoned ruins, drowned landscapes, forests, nightmare architecture, and mysterious locations hiding the remains of a forgotten civilization.

Every area tells part of the story through environmental details, hidden paths, and disturbing discoveries.

Survive Terrifying Creatures

Face horrifying enemies and powerful creatures throughout your journey. Some hunt in darkness, others emerge from the water, while massive beings lurk beyond sight.

Survival requires awareness, movement, and careful timing during dangerous encounters.

Cinematic Experience

Experience a cinematic third-person fantasy adventure focused on atmosphere, tension, environmental storytelling, and immersive visuals.

As the world deepens, reality itself begins to distort.

Features

  • Cinematic third-person horror gameplay

  • Atmospheric exploration across haunting environments

  • Deadly creatures and terrifying encounters

  • Dark fantasy world inspired by nightmares and decay

  • Environmental storytelling and hidden lore

  • Immersive visuals and cinematic presentation

  • Psychological horror elements and surreal environments

Survival is only the beginning.
